verdict.rationale: Datadog's Agent Observability Experiments feature documents creating and versioning datasets and comparing results to see how prompt, model, or provider changes affect performance, which covers offline evaluation against datasets. Evaluations can be tied to production spans, but nothing shows datasets being curated from production traces. missing for 10: documented workflow for curating datasets from production traces/spans, detail on how offline experiment runs execute evaluators, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can curate datasets from production traces and run offline evaluations against them

citations.quote: It helps you understand how changes to prompts, models, providers, or system architecture affect performance.
Agent Observability associates evaluations with individual spans so you can view the inputs and outputs that led to a specific evaluation.
